title.zh: US Seeks Forfeiture of $61 Million in Crypto Linked to Alleged Iranian Oil Scheme
title.en: US Seeks Forfeiture of $61 Million in Crypto Linked to Alleged Iranian Oil Scheme

current_state.zh: U.S. prosecutors are seeking forfeiture of roughly $61 million in cryptocurrency allegedly tied to a network that laundered over $1.5 billion in Iranian oil proceeds through Binance accounts benefiting Iran's military and the IRGC.
current_state.en: U.S. prosecutors are seeking forfeiture of roughly $61 million in cryptocurrency allegedly tied to a network that laundered over $1.5 billion in Iranian oil proceeds through Binance accounts benefiting Iran's military and the IRGC.
